C0328.title: Telecom Insider Sells Dormant Numbers, Aiding Telecom Fraud
C0328.summary: The report reveals that insiders at a telecom operator exploited their positions to sell dormant phone numbers, facilitating telecom and online fraud. These numbers were used to register accounts on various internet platforms, allowing criminals to conceal their real identities and carry out downstream illegal activities.
